+----------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                      | **Rocuronium **                                                                                      | **Suxamethonium **                                                                               |
+======================+======================================================================================================+==================================================================================================+
| **Use**              | Amino-steroid non-depolarising muscle relaxant for induction and maintenance of neuromuscular block  | Depolarising Muscle relaxant                                                                     |
|                      |                                                                                                      |                                                                                                  |
|                      | Onset 1.5-3min lasting \~40min (dose dependant) with large interpersonal variability                 | for intubation                                                                                   |
|                      |                                                                                                      |                                                                                                  |
|                      |                                                                                                      | Onset 1min lasting \~2-3min                                                                      |
+----------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Dose **            | 0.6mg kg IV routine induction, 1.2mg/kg for RSI                                                      | 1-2mg / kg IV, 3-4mg/kg IM                                                                       |
|                      |                                                                                                      |                                                                                                  |
|                      | ED95 0.3mg/kg                                                                                        | ED95 0.5mg/kg                                                                                    |
+----------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Physiochemical **  | Clear colourless solution,                                                                           | Clear colourless solution                                                                        |
|                      |                                                                                                      |                                                                                                  |
|                      | prepared at 10mg/mg                                                                                  | pH 3 prepared as 50mg/ml                                                                         |
+----------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Pharmacokinetic ** | Minimal metabolism (\<5%)                                                                            | 30% protein bound, Vd 0.25L/kg                                                                   |
|                      |                                                                                                      |                                                                                                  |
|                      | Nil Active Metabolites                                                                               | Rapid hydrolysis by plasma cholinesterase - only 20% of dose reaching NMJ                        |
|                      |                                                                                                      |                                                                                                  |
|                      | Mainly Excreted unchanged in bile and 20% to urine                                                   | Minimal elimination due to rapid metabolism                                                      |
+----------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Pharmacodynamic**  | Competitive antagonist of ACH at the postsynaptic nACh receptor in the NMJ                           | Formed as 2 linked ACh molecules → binds to nACh receptor at the NMJ →depolarisation             |
|                      |                                                                                                      |                                                                                                  |
|                      | May ↑HR with large doses                                                                             | Prolonged depolarisation due to acetylcholinesterase not being able to metabolise Suxamethonium  |
|                      |                                                                                                      |                                                                                                  |
|                      | Risk of anaphylaxis →↑ with previous use of pholcodeine                                              | - Anaphylaxis                                                                                    |
|                      |                                                                                                      | - Suxamethonium Apnoea                                                                           |
|                      |                                                                                                      | - Malignant Hyperthermia                                                                         |
|                      |                                                                                                      | - Arrhythmia/Bradycardia                                                                         |
|                      |                                                                                                      | - Hyperkalaemia                                                                                  |
|                      |                                                                                                      | - Myalgia                                                                                        |
|                      |                                                                                                      | - ↑IOP                                                                                           |
|                      |                                                                                                      | - ↑ICP                                                                                           |
|                      |                                                                                                      | - ↑ Intragastric pressure                                                                        |
+----------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
